bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
CURRENT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')
EXPECTED=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-like-love-061d9b8 --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$CURRENT" = "$EXPECTED" || { echo GAYBBS_LIKE_LOVE_IMAGE_CHANGED; exit 51; }
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$CID" | grep -c .)" = 1 || exit 52
test "$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$EXPECTED" || { echo GAYBBS_RUNNING_OLDER_IMAGE; exit 53; }
test "$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 54
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 55
echo GAYBBS_LIKE_LOVE_LIVE_IMAGE_MATCH_PASS
echo EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA=061d9b8eff77f112914e8e53632c7cf7ab162798
echo GAYBBS_SERVICE_RUNNING_PASS
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_SERVICE_ACTIVE_PASS
